result.rationale: Create one manager-level Health Park at Avenir record rather than a pending Jupiter Medical Center campus transaction. Direct manager, registry, owner/developer and property-party evidence establishes SFG PBG Medical, LLC as the closed ProjectCo, Fengate/Fund IV, Stonemont and The Sina Companies as the investment and development partners, and Jupiter Medical Center as the 15-year tenant/operator. The initial hospital and medical-office scope is under construction and no later sale or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

Owner/developer evidence for the canonical name, Sina role and bounded initial development scope.
